plugins.name: agentsight
plugins.description: AgentSight conversation analytics for AI agent applications, as three skills: an integration workflow (code-first discovery, a consent-aware interview, SDK wiring, and file-exporter verification before any claim of success), a migration workflow for conversation history that already exists somewhere else (source inspection, a mapping interview, and a validated bulk-import file), and a knowledge base for integrated codebases (the full tracking and API surface, dashboard metrics, the embeddable dashboard, and debugging).
